title: Gate 5 two-user week is deferred until an external design partner exists; single-user legs stand as measured
context: Gate 5 (re-measure, kill criterion) has live single-user numbers for both legs (status from held state; approval → receipt → held state) and the cross-domain chain, measured 2026-09-12. The two-user week needs a second real person doing their own work on the same partition; the pilot organization has no second participant available (2026-09-15). The planned week of 2026-09-08 was missed for that reason.
decision: Mark Gate 5 as 'single-user: measured; two-user: deferred, needs design partner' in ROADMAP.md and stop treating the missed week as a blocker for other work. The two-user leg runs when an external design partner (a small clinic or office that already lives in a CRM) is on the partition for five working days. Until then every public claim is scoped to 'one live user' plus 'emulated organization' and says which population each number comes from. The gate's acceptance rules are unchanged: an incomplete or synthetic week seals inconclusive, never pass.
consequences: Roadmap priority after 1.36 shifts to engineering items (policy-evaluator noise, CI enforcement of blocking constraints, task-record defaults) and to finding a design partner, which is also the first external user.
The hero swap, the with/without benchmark publication and the positioning post stay gated on a real two-user number or on an explicit decision to publish single-user numbers as such.
alternatives_rejected: Emulate the two-user week: the emulation (3 Sofias, 10 clinics, 12/12 and 5/5) already exists and is a different population; the gate asks whether a second human sees another's actions through held state, which emulation cannot answer, and external-acceptance tests refuse to seal it as pass.
Use a second agent principal as the second user: that is Gate 4, already passed live on 2026-09-12.
Play both roles with a time gap: same knowledge in one head; measures nothing.
Recruit a colleague inside the pilot organization: nobody available; if that changes the week runs as planned.
